_note: The registered protocol of cell VERIFY-1, written BEFORE any contact. Every number here was measured or derived MODEL-FREE at registration: the composed and protocol hashes through core.config.compose / core.config.protocol_hash, the split identities through data.splits.split_identity_hash, the population counts and per-row permutations through scripts/build_slurp_verify1_material.py over the sealed ROLL-1 bundle, and the prompt-fit and leakage figures through scripts/flights/batch/verify1_dry_run.py. Zero model, tokenizer, encoder, scorer, GPU and network contacts; no audio decoded.

coordinator_rulings_2026_09_25: Implement the recommended option: a NEW opt-in predecessor binding 'sealed-samples-manifest' in rails.phase_material whose loader reads row['solver_group']['samples'] of a sealed manifest, renders each sample through the existing render_rollout_answer in a permutation drawn from a seed pinned in predecessor_source, and returns that block as the bound state content with NO delivered-answer anchor prepended. Every existing sealed-manifest cell stays byte-identical (opt-in by the new binding name only). Speech rides the ordinary phase-program path, so no new D2 arm and no construction-visible field.

Population ruling: fly all 625 R01C rows. The 420 rows whose five samples render to at least two DISTINCT answers are the informative population and carry the probe's reading; the 205 rows whose samples render to one distinct answer are a built-in POSITION-BIAS control. Report both strata separately beside the primary complete-roster result.

registry_record.why_not_scoring: The cell asks for no per-candidate score, ranking or margin, so nothing in its sealed output can be read as a model-produced score. Claiming the scoring operator would claim a quantity the response format cannot carry.

decision_rule.primary_read: All 625 rows: paired pooled official SLU-F1 of the chosen sealed sample versus mean-single. Report sample-0, medoid and explicitly metric-limited oracle references. Report 420 content-distinct, 414 all-parsed, 205 identical-answer controls and 225 row-F1-disagreeing strata separately beside the complete-roster result.
decision_rule.self_verification_works_if: The complete-roster paired CI95 lower bound for pooled SLU-F1 gain versus mean-single is positive and intent passes the preregistered operational non-inferiority guard from the R01C own-null. This opens a subsequent evidence-rich Reviewer design, not a system admission or test claim.
decision_rule.the_sampling_line_closes_if: No supported complete-roster selection benefit: stop this bounded selection route without claiming that larger sampling can never help. Position histograms diagnose presentation bias; similarity or non-significance of those histograms alone never proves absence of content information.
decision_rule.structural_acceptance: COMPLETED source and verifier manifests; exact 625 roster identities; every chosen position traceably resolves to the pinned source samples. Invalid choices use predeclared sealed source sample index 0 and remain in complete-roster estimates with separate failure/fallback counts. Selected malformed-source candidates are tagged, not dropped.
decision_rule.intervals: Paired utterance-cluster bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20260915; official pooled counts and per-row F1 are separate estimands.
decision_rule.null_interpretation: VAR1 PLAN/PLANR intent margin is an operational guard only; its SLU half-width is not a universal threshold or an estimator of selector contrast variance.

execution_route: The four-row smoke flies through core.flight.cli worker under its own lease; the 625-row arm flies through the shared core.flight.cli campaign over the committed single-cell plan configs/campaign/slurp-native-stage3-verify-1-v1.json, attaching to the resident session serving-slurp-native-candidate-five-train-a-np4-v1 (attach only, never spawn or stop). Queued through the SAEA-Batch-Driver scheduled task (decision 77) by scripts/flights/batch/batch_chain_verify1.sh: ONE step, smoke then arm.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, program, prompt, permutation-seed, geometry or cap change. This registration pre-authorises no recovery; a root-diagnosed recovery re-registration is a separate act once the cell is flown. A partial manifest is never read.

form.no_retrieval: The choose phase declares knowledge 'none'; the fragment declares no phase_supply and no knowledge_stores. The five candidates ARE the evidence under test. Supplying the plan's retrieved exemplars would make a negative result unattributable -- verifier failure or misleading supply, the failure mode cells IDX and EFF-1 recorded -- and could not reproduce the generator's information set anyway, because the plan's Solver also saw a Perception candidate state and a slot-contract candidate supply for which a one-phase program has no seat. REGISTERED AS A DEVIATION from the coordinator's 'clone the vectors and the MINUS-R01 exemplar release' instruction: the packets, the receipts and the MINUS-R01 release are cloned from configs/baseline/slurp-native-stage3-var1-plan-r01c-baseline-v1.json, the MINUS-R01 release being BOUND as the invisible leakage authority (knowledge_snapshot_relpath), while the two sealed speech query-vector files are NOT carried because no phase retrieves and a pinned vector file nothing reads pins nothing.

program.why_ceiling_two: 'always-run-full-program' walks each phase once, so the program spends exactly ONE contact per row; the ceiling carries one contact of headroom and is a BOUND, never a target. The registered generation cap is 625 x 2 = 1,250 against an expected spend of 625.

response_format.chosen_position: integer, enum 1..5 -- the 1-BASED POSITION in the rendered candidate block, never a sealed sample index. The block deliberately never shows the sample index, so a position must be resolved through the per-row permutation and a verifier cannot pick 'sample 0' by naming a number it read off the prompt. An enum rather than minimum/maximum because an enum lowers to a closed set of literal alternatives in every JSON-schema-to-grammar version this study has served.
response_format.reason: string, maxLength 160 -- one bounded diagnostic line

context_only.note: CONTEXT ONLY, never a gate: cross-flight half-widths on other rosters at other n, plus the ROLL-AA within-flight floor at n = 200. This cell's comparison is BETWEEN-flight (its chosen-sample column against the sealed ROLL-1 sample columns), so the within-flight floor is not its margin either.

margins.primary_note: R01C has no own null of its own yet. The VAR-1 family's VAR1-PLAN / VAR1-PLANR pair (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VAR1-PLAN-R01C-V1 and SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VAR1-PLANR-R01C-V1) measures it on this exact roster, and that half-width is the margin this cell's SLU comparison is read against. Until it is sealed the comparison is reported with the context half-widths below and explicitly labelled UNRESOLVED; no verdict is drawn from a margin this program does not yet have.

populations.ruling: All 625 rows are the primary population. Report the 420 content-distinct rows, 414 content-distinct rows with all candidates parsed, 205 identical-answer controls, and 225 row-F1-disagreeing rows separately. Preserve the six rows containing nine malformed source samples; flag their canonical empty renderings. Invalid verifier responses fall back to sealed source sample index 0. Do not exclude failures from complete-roster estimates. Position histograms are descriptive, not tests of semantic selection.
populations.why_the_control_is_not_waste: A third of this roster is degenerate for selection, which is exactly why a prefix smoke would have proved nothing: the first four R01C rows all render one distinct candidate. Flying them costs 205 contacts and buys the only clean position-bias measurement available.

prohibitions: No official complete scoring job is scheduled: the delivered text is a CHOICE, not a SLURP answer. The read reuses the sealed ROLL-1 per-sample official scores and the offline aggregation read's derived columns and re-derives nothing.
No gold, reference, transcript or future turn enters runtime. The loader refuses a custody object carrying a reference-shaped key.

R01C is a CONSTRUCTION roster (owner decisions 28 and 86): every number this cell produces is a development number and never a test claim. Any effect that separates from this roster's own null must be re-read on TRAIN Fold A and on DEV-2000-ADDED before it is a claim of any kind.
No second answering model, retriever or judge; no tool authority on any phase.
purpose: Cell VERIFY-1, the Stage-3 VERIFIER-SELECTION PROBE (board route F11; Stage-3 algorithm family inference-time-verification-v1, operator SELECTION). ONE contact per R01C construction row carries that row's OWN speech plus the FIVE sealed ROLL-1 Solver candidate answers for that same row, in a per-row presentation order pinned by the config, with NO delivered-answer anchor and no retrieved knowledge, and asks the frozen core to name the candidate the speech supports under a two-field contract. The question it exists for is the ORACLE gap the offline sample-aggregation read measured over this same sealed rollout: best-of-5 is +6.55 pp pooled SLU-F1 and +12.55 pp on the 225 score-disagreeing rows, and NOT ONE deterministic agreement rule the read could build reached any of it. Can the frozen core VERIFY better than it GENERATES? DESCRIPTIVE: no admission verdict, no comparator arm, no gate, nothing admitted, released or locked.

permutation.per_row_not_per_run: One order shared by every row would confound position bias with sample-index bias, and the 205 single-answer rows exist precisely to measure position bias with no confound.
permutation.realised_index_to_position_spread: Each sealed sample index lands in each of the five positions between 109 and 141 times over 625 rows (uniform expectation 125), so the pinned order introduces no systematic index-to-position bias.
permutation.rule: balanced-block-v1: hash-rank the full sealed source roster, then assign every cyclic rotation of a seeded Fisher-Yates permutation within each five-row block. Each source index appears at each position exactly 125 times on the full 625 rows.

refusals_by_name: a row whose sample count differs from the registered expectation
a row whose solver sample indices are not 0..N-1, or carry a duplicate or non-integer sample_index
a solver sample whose parse_status is outside the closed vocabulary {ok, malformed}

a row, solver_group or sample record carrying a reference-shaped key (gold / reference / annotation / ground_truth / truth / target / expected / correct) -- refused rather than read around, so no gold can ever reach a candidate block
a missing or unpinned permutation seed, and a seed that is not a non-negative integer
a predecessor_source whose key set is not exactly the five this binding declares (the three-key sealed-manifest source is refused here)
a state_fill declared beside this binding (every registered fill reads the state as ONE sealed answer)
use of the binding beside prepared_execution_units
a manifest whose bytes do not hash to the configured sha256
duplicate sealed rows for one sample id, and a requested sample the bundle does not carry

unparseable_sample_disposition.rule: A sealed sample whose parse_status is not 'ok' renders the canonical EMPTY answer rails.stage3_advantage_material.render_rollout_answer already writes for a failed parse. The ROW IS FLOWN: the candidate count on the wire must be the registered five on every row, because a row shown four candidates would be under a different contract from every other row of the same cell. The row is EXCLUDED from the primary informative read, because one of its candidates is a harness constant rather than something the core said.

the_harness_change.what: One NEW predecessor binding, 'sealed-samples-manifest', in rails.phase_material, plus the single dispatch seam rails.phase_material.sealed_states_for_spec that the three core.flight.FlightRuntime sites needing external per-sample states now share (the prompt-budget estimate, the pinned prompt-fit verification and the real flight binding). Written as one function rather than three copies of a branch so a binding can never reach the wire through one site and be padded at another.
the_harness_change.why_a_second_binding_and_not_a_flag: rails.phase_material.sealed_states_from_manifest builds exactly ONE state per row from the sealed row's 'text' -- the DELIVERED answer -- and never opens solver_group. A verifier contact needs the opposite: all N samples, none privileged, and no delivered-answer anchor, because an anchor would tell the contact which candidate the harness already committed. Widening the first loader would have made every already-flown sealed-manifest cell's prompt depend on a new argument's default.

prompt_fit_kind: Dry run is an estimate only. Mandatory live_phase_fit covers every actual request before generation.
